candidate_filter.scope: Conservative read-only candidate screen, not an established quality threshold or geometry guarantee.

candidate_index_artifact.schema: primitive_N_edges: int32 [K,2] primitive-local exported vertex indices; primitive_N_faces: int32 [K,2] triangle ordinals; rows correspond; no positions or geometry authored.

coordinate_space: glTF right-handed +Y-up world rest positions, authored meters; Blender conversion [x,-z,y]
limitations: No welding, geometry generation, image edit, render, provider call, or production edit.
Exact coincident positions indicate possible seams/splits, not proven shared physical topology; they never become candidate shared edges.
Candidate counts do not prove silhouette visibility, groom direction, density, animation deformation, or appearance quality.
Indices are exported primitive-local indices, not anatomical or original source-vertex identities.
Normal/skin coherence is inspected only at rest; no self-intersection, motion or physical-validity claim.

bake.assumption: Authored short-pile lighting detail, not recovered fibers or measured coat density

atlas.layout: One ordered longest-edge local triangle per padded grid cell; no shared chart texels

selection.rule: Exclude recorded normal_continuity target materials by source name, not UV set or coordinates; all other non-undercoat materials remain unselected.
